g.text: Five short preassembled cells inside one barrel
Glass: light blue | Spacers: green | Retainers: dark gray | Barrels/cells: case colors
Insert each optical group from the −Z opening of
its cell, seat and center it in a fixture, then
apply and cure local adhesive bonds.
From the +Z specimen-side opening, insert the
G1, G2, G3, G4 and G5 cells in order, followed
Common Ø18 cell exteriors establish barrel
centering. Individual shoulders and bonds hold
the glass. The main ring compresses metal cell
end faces rather than the glass stack.
Nose retaining ring → G5 cell → G4 cell → G3
cell → G2 cell → G1 cell → barrel end shoulder.
−Z faces the tube lens; +Z faces the specimen. STOP lies on a curved G3 surface, so no separate flat metal stop is added. Original glass
Nominal demo geometry. No new aperture/ray check. Ports, threads, tolerances and preload require CAD/engineering review.
